field_principles.delta_heldout: the induction-quality lift the refinement loop produces; PRIMARY -- the exact mechanism the diagnosis named as the binding wall.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal-prefixed, numbers-first; a continuous heldout delta with real headroom cannot come back 'no headroom'.
field_principles.inference_substrate: live_llm_inference -- real ThinkingCap-27B + Qwen-9B GGUF generation across up to 3 CEGIS rounds/cell; 60s floor.
field_principles.random_seed: LLM sampling is server-side stochastic; trials are per-game replicates (same seeded window) -- paired by GAME, bootstrap over games.
field_principles.refactor_emission_rate: attribution guard -- a low rate means a null is a budget-overrun mechanical artifact, not evidence against refinement (design sec 5 branch 3).
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content hash over harness + reinduction + world-model code + generator/roster config + rows.
field_principles.solve_provenance: development_proxy -- PUBLIC-game offline measurement of the LIVE refinement mechanism; NOT a hidden-game solve.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False -- heldout_accuracy is exact-match against real recorded transitions the engine was NOT fit to (held-out 1/3 split); oracle-distinct.

memorization_detector.definition: structural AST scan of the induced engine() source; is_memorizing := >=3 int literals (>=10, i.e. coordinate range not action/color codes) matching an observed-window changed-cell row/col index. GATED quantity = before/after DELTA (cancels the dense-window chance-match confound symmetrically).

methodology_note: Route induction through execute_bounded_llm_reinduction (arc_llm_reinduction.py:654, min_heldout_accuracy=1.0, candidate_provider=the loaded engine, load_engine + plan_in_model from arc_executable_world_model) instead of single-shot proposer.induce. Per-round heldout from outcome.rounds[*]['heldout_accuracy'] (exact-match on the held-out 1/3 split via select_trusted_world_model; CARNOT_ARC_TRUST_METRIC forced OFF so the metric is exact, not cell_recall). round 0 = induce, rounds 1-2 = refactor. Proposer mirrors tonight's reason-induce (codeonly OFF, /think, tries=1, 16384 budget); round 0 uses the loop's STANDARD induce (the live path) -- disclosed minor divergence from tonight's _induce_no_fence, but the rigorous quantity is the INTERNAL round-0-vs-refined delta. Servers sequential (no contention, no world_model.py race). This is a DIAGNOSTIC over the EXISTING live refinement mechanism, NOT a live-path modification.

model_specs.name: Qwen3.5-9B-MTP
model_specs.role: frozen live-generator arm (raw /completion); locates the model-size threshold

preregistration.gate_emission_confound: refactor-emission rate<=0.6 (mechanical artifact, not evidence against refinement)
preregistration.gate_honest_negative: delta<=0.05 pooled AND memorization unchanged AND emission healthy
preregistration.gate_positive: pooled mean delta_heldout>0.15 across >=12 games AND bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0 AND positive on >=50% of games AND paired sign-test p<0.05 AND memorization rate drops >=0.2 absolute AND degradation guard holds AND refactor-emission rate>0.6
preregistration.primary_metric: delta_heldout = heldout(best refined round) - heldout(round 0), per game + pooled
preregistration.retire_if_same_verdict: on HONEST-NEGATIVE, do NOT re-propose small-model induction-refinement variants; change the model class (bigger offline model) or the architecture (reactive-with-filter)
preregistration.roster_selection_rule: the 12 fastest-to-induce (by tonight REQ-ARC-WMTE-5726 mean ThinkingCap wall) of the 17 games ThinkingCap induced on tonight, PLUS ft09 (so both degradation-guard games sp80+ft09 are present). Fixed BEFORE the run; order = ascending TC wall.

question: Does the EXISTING verifier-grounded CEGIS refinement loop (execute_bounded_llm_reinduction, min_heldout_accuracy=1.0) LIFT world-model induction quality (per-round heldout_accuracy) over tonight's SINGLE-SHOT baseline, for a frozen 9B and 27B model? Which side of the WorldCoder/E3-vs-'Falsification-Not-Exposure' small-frozen-model boundary does Carnot fall on?

sample_size.note: 17 games ThinkingCap induced on tonight; 13 pre-registered here (>=12 gate floor). Trials add per-game stability, not additional independent degrees of freedom.
sample_size.paired_unit: game (delta_heldout averaged over trials + models, paired by game)
